## Problem / Use Case
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe it clearly (e.g. *"I want to evaluate agents using vLLM / LiteLLM endpoints..."*).

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the API, CLI, or UI working.

## Alternatives Considered
A description of any alternative solutions, tools, or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockup screenshots, benchmark task ideas, or links to relevant research papers or tools.
